styles.story: Rich storybook game painting, warm glowing light, soft painterly edges, bright saturated colours, friendly and magical for children aged 8 to 12, no text, no letters.

pictures.name: cavern-11
pictures.prompt: Side-on cut-away view inside the ground: a cosy underground burrow lined with soft green moss, ferns and tangled tree roots hanging at the edges, little glowing mushrooms in the corners. The top fifth is a rocky cave ceiling with a flat stone ledge. The middle of the picture is calm, smooth and low-detail with soft colour so small monsters and gems will stand out, detail only at the edges and the bottom, wide landscape.
